notes.title: ORBIT is released!
notes.notes:
Finally, the day has come! ORBIT is out now!

We've worked really hard for a surprising amount of time to make the game happen, and we really hope you enjoy it. Now i guess all that's left is gathering some folks (Perhaps some pizza?) and playing the game! 

Yours sincerely,
4Bit Games

notes.title: Testers wanted, everyone invited! Grab your ORBIT beta
notes.notes:
Hello fellow orbiters! The last couple of weeks have been super exciting for us at 4Bit Games, and we're absolutely stoked for the release of ORBIT on the 30th! Are you ready?

Before we're releasing to the public though, we've got to run some final tests on language and stability. This is why we're inviting you guys to give us feedback on ORBIT prior to release! Ideally we'd love to have people from all over the world tell us how horribly we've botched the translations, and possibly how bad ORBIT sets their computer on fire. Or in other words, play ORBIT, let us know what you think and perhaps help us tune up the translation a (4)bit. 

If you'd like to join the beta crew, we're totally looking forward to PC/Steam players that speak English, German, French, Spanish, Russian or Japanese, especially the ones who enjoy brawler games and have at least one more friend to play with in the same room (it is a local multiplayer only game!). Just shoot us an email to eduardo at 4bitgames dot com with your language, and you will have a copy for Steam and some really simple instructions to follow.

Again, we're just so damn ready to show you guys what ORBIT has become, and we're just around the corner! 

Love,
4Bit Games
[img]http://4bitgames.com/presskit/orbit/images/GIF_2.gif[/img]
